translations.literal: Sacrifice to the altars of soil and grain does not take Shennong's great merit with plow and hoe but singles out Gonggong and Lieshan—because the Three Sovereigns' primordial traces are not taken as teaching.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice to the altars of soil and grain does not take Shennong's great merit with plow and hoe but singles out Gonggong and Lieshan—because the Three Sovereigns' primordial traces are not taken as teaching.

sentences.zh: 彼秦靜何人，而知社稷、先農為二，而藉田有二壇乎？

translations.literal: What sort of man was Qin Jing, to know that altars of soil and grain and First Farmer are two, and that the sacred field has two altars?
translations.idiomatic: What sort of man was Qin Jing, to claim that altars of soil and grain and First Farmer are two, and that the sacred field requires two altars?

sentences.zh: 先農、王社，一也，皆后稷、句龍異名而分祭，牲以四牢。

translations.literal: First Farmer and King's Altar are one; both are Hou Ji and Goulong under different names but separately sacrificed, victims in four pens.
translations.idiomatic: First Farmer and King's Altar are one; both are Hou Ji and Goulong under different names but separately sacrificed, with victims in four pens.

sentences.zh: 」欽明又言：「漢祀禹，謬也。

translations.literal: Qinming also said: "Han sacrificed to Yu—an error.
translations.idiomatic: Qinming also said: "Han sacrifice to Yu was an error.

sentences.zh: 今欲正王社、先農之號而未決，乃更加二祀，不可。

translations.literal: Now wishing to correct the names of King's Altar and First Farmer but undecided, yet adding two more sacrifices—this cannot be.
translations.idiomatic: Now they wished to correct the names of King's Altar and First Farmer but remained undecided, yet proposed adding two more sacrifices—that cannot stand.

sentences.zh: 」叔夏、齊賢等乃奏言：「經無先農，禮曰『王自為立社，曰王社。

translations.literal: Shuxia and Qixian then memorialized: "The classics have no First Farmer; the Rites say 'The king establishes his own altar of soil, called the King's Altar.'
translations.idiomatic: Shuxia and Qixian then memorialized: "The classics have no First Farmer; the Rites say 'The king establishes his own altar of soil, called the King's Altar.'

sentences.zh: 』先儒以為在藉田也。

translations.literal: Former scholars held it was at the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: Former scholars held it was at the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 永徽中猶曰藉田，垂拱後乃為先農。

translations.literal: In the Yonghui era it was still called sacred field; after Zhongguan it became First Farmer.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yonghui era it was still called sacred field; after Zhongguan it became First Farmer.

sentences.zh: 然則先農與社一神，今先農壇請改曰帝社壇，以合古王社之義。

translations.literal: Thus First Farmer and the altar of soil are one spirit; now the First Farmer Altar should be changed to Emperor's Altar of Soil to match ancient King's Altar meaning.
translations.idiomatic: Thus First Farmer and the altar of soil are one spirit; the First Farmer Altar should be renamed Emperor's Altar of Soil to match the ancient King's Altar.

sentences.zh: 其祭，準令以孟春吉亥祠后土，以句龍氏配。

translations.literal: Its sacrifice, per regulations, on the auspicious hai of the first month sacrifices to Lord of Soil, with the Goulong clan as associate.
translations.idiomatic: Its sacrifice, per regulations, on the auspicious hai of the first month honors Lord of Soil, with the Goulong clan as associate.

sentences.zh: 」於是為帝社壇，又立帝稷壇於西，如太社、太稷，而壇不設方色，以異於太社。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Emperor's Altar of Soil was made, and an Emperor's Altar of Grain was set west of it like the Grand Altars of Soil and Grain, but the altar had no directional color, differing from the Grand Altar of Soil.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Emperor's Altar of Soil was built, and an Emperor's Altar of Grain west of it on the model of the Grand Altars of Soil and Grain, but without directional coloring, differing from the Grand Altar of Soil.

sentences.zh: 開元十九年，停帝稷而祀神農氏於壇上，以后稷配。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Kaiyuan, the Emperor's Altar of Grain was stopped and Shennong was sacrificed on the altar, with Hou Ji as associate.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Kaiyuan, the Emperor's Altar of Grain was discontinued and Shennong was sacrificed on the altar, with Hou Ji as associate.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，親祀神農於東郊，配以句芒，遂躬耕盡壠止。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he personally sacrificed to Shennong at the eastern suburb, with Gou Mang as associate, then plowed in person to the end of the ridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he personally sacrificed to Shennong at the eastern suburb, with Gou Mang as associate, then plowed in person to the end of the ridge.

sentences.zh: 肅宗乾元二年，詔去耒耜雕刻，命有司改造之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianyuan under Suzong, an edict removed carved decoration from plow and hoe and ordered responsible offices to remake them.
translations.idiomatic: In Suzong's second year of Qianyuan, an edict removed carved decoration from plow and hoe and ordered responsible offices to remake them.

sentences.zh: 天子出通化門，釋軷而入壇，遂祭神農氏，以后稷配。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven left Tonghua Gate, released the shaft-block and entered the altar, then sacrificed to Shennong, with Hou Ji as associate.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven left Tonghua Gate, released the shaft-block and entered the altar, then sacrificed to Shennong, with Hou Ji as associate.

sentences.zh: 冕而朱紘，躬九推焉。

translations.literal: He wore the cap with vermilion tassels and personally pushed nine furrows.
translations.idiomatic: He wore the ceremonial cap with vermilion tassels and personally pushed nine furrows.

sentences.zh: 憲宗元和五年，詔以來歲正月藉田。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yuanhe under Xianzong, an edict ordered plowing the sacred field in the first month of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianzong's fifth year of Yuanhe, an edict ordered plowing the sacred field in the first month of the coming year.

sentences.zh: 太常脩撰韋公肅言：「藉田禮廢久矣，有司無可考。

translations.literal: Editor Wei Gongsu of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices said: "Sacred-field ritual has long been abandoned; responsible offices have nothing to consult.
translations.idiomatic: Editor Wei Gongsu of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices said: "Sacred-field ritual had long been abandoned; responsible offices had nothing to consult.

sentences.zh: 」乃據禮經參采開元、乾元故事，為先農壇於藉田。

translations.literal: " He then drew on the ritual classics and Kaiyuan and Qianyuan precedents and made a First Farmer Altar at the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: He then drew on the ritual classics and Kaiyuan and Qianyuan precedents and built a First Farmer Altar at the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 皇帝夾侍二人、正衣二人，侍中一人奉耒耜，中書令一人、禮部尚書一人侍從，司農卿一人授耒耜於侍中，太僕卿一人執牛，左、右衞將軍各一人侍衞。

translations.literal: The emperor was flanked by two attendants and two rectifiers of dress; one attendant director bore plow and hoe; one Secretariat Director and one Minister of Rites attended; one Director of Agriculture gave plow and hoe to the attendant director; one Director of the Palace Studs held the ox; left and right guards generals each one attended.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was flanked by two attendants and two dress rectifiers; one attendant director bore plow and hoe; one Secretariat Director and one Minister of Rites attended; the Director of Agriculture handed plow and hoe to the attendant director; the Director of the Palace Studs held the ox; left and right guards generals each attended.

sentences.zh: 三公以宰相攝，九卿以左右僕射、尚書、御史大夫攝，三諸侯以正員一品官及嗣王攝。

translations.literal: The Three Dukes were represented by chancellors; nine directors by left and right vice directors, ministers, and censors; three feudal lords by regular first-rank officials and imperial clansmen.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Dukes were represented by chancellors; nine directors by left and right vice directors, ministers, and censors; three feudal lords by regular first-rank officials and imperial clansmen.

sentences.zh: 推數一用古制。

translations.literal: The number of furrows followed ancient regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The number of furrows followed ancient regulation.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使一人、太常卿一人贊禮；

translations.literal: One ritual commissioner and one Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices presented ritual;
translations.idiomatic: One ritual commissioner and one Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices presented ritual;

sentences.zh: 三公、九卿、諸侯執牛三十人，用六品以下官，皆服袴褶。

translations.literal: the Three Dukes, nine directors, and feudal lords had thirty ox-handlers using officials of sixth rank and below, all in trousers and jackets.
translations.idiomatic: the Three Dukes, nine directors, and feudal lords had thirty ox-handlers drawn from officials of sixth rank and below, all in trousers and jackets.

sentences.zh: 御耒耜二，幷韜皆以青。

translations.literal: Two imperial plows and covers, all green.
translations.idiomatic: Two imperial plows and covers, all green.

sentences.zh: 其制度取合農用，不雕飾，畢日收之。

translations.literal: Their design suited farming use, without ornament; they were stored away when finished.
translations.idiomatic: Their design suited farming use, without ornament; they were stored away when finished.

sentences.zh: 藉耒耜丈席二。

translations.literal: Sacred plow and hoe with one-zhang mats, two.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred plow, hoe, and one-zhang mats: two sets.

sentences.zh: 先農壇高五尺，廣五丈，四出陛，其色青。

translations.literal: The First Farmer Altar five chi high, five zhang wide, with steps on four sides, colored green.
translations.idiomatic: The First Farmer Altar was five chi high and five zhang wide, with steps on four sides, colored green.

sentences.zh: 三公、九卿、諸侯耒十有五。

translations.literal: Fifteen plows for the Three Dukes, nine directors, and feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen plows for the Three Dukes, nine directors, and feudal lords.

sentences.zh: 御耒之牛四，其二，副也。

translations.literal: Four oxen for the imperial plow, two of them spare.
translations.idiomatic: Four oxen for the imperial plow, two of them spare.

sentences.zh: 幷牛衣。

translations.literal: Ox garments as well.
translations.idiomatic: Ox garments as well.

sentences.zh: 每牛各一人，絳衣介幘，取閑農務者，禮司以人贊導之。

translations.literal: One man per ox, in crimson clothes and kerchief, chosen from those idle in farm work; the ritual office guided them.
translations.idiomatic: One man per ox, in crimson clothes and kerchief, chosen from those available for farm work; the ritual office guided them.

sentences.zh: 執耒持耜，以高品中官二人，不袴褶。

translations.literal: Those holding plow and hoe were two middle-rank inner officials, not in trousers and jackets.
translations.idiomatic: Those holding plow and hoe were two middle-rank inner officials, not in trousers and jackets.

sentences.zh: 皇帝詣望耕位，通事舍人分導文、武就耕所。

translations.literal: When the emperor reached the gaze-plowing position, the Master of Ceremonies guided civil and military officials to the plowing places.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor reached the gaze-plowing position, the Master of Ceremonies guided civil and military officials to the plowing places.

sentences.zh: 太常帥其屬用庶人二十八，以郊社令一人押之。

translations.literal: The Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices led twenty-eight commoners, with one suburban and altar commissioner supervising.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices led twenty-eight commoners, supervised by one suburban and altar commissioner.

sentences.zh: 太常少卿一人，率庶人趨耕所。

translations.literal: One Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices led the commoners to the plowing place.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices led the commoners to the plowing place.

sentences.zh: 博士六人，分贊耕禮。

translations.literal: Six erudites apiece guided the plowing ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Six erudites guided the plowing ritual in rotation.

sentences.zh: 司農少卿一人，督視庶人終千畝。

translations.literal: One Vice Director of Agriculture supervised the commoners to finish the thousand mu.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Director of Agriculture supervised the commoners to finish the thousand mu.

sentences.zh: 廩犧令二人，間一人奉耒耜授司農卿，以五品、六品清官攝；

translations.literal: Two Directors of Granaries and Sacrificial Animals, one at a time giving plow and hoe to the Director of Agriculture, represented by fifth- and sixth-rank pure officials;
translations.idiomatic: Two Directors of Granaries and Sacrificial Animals, one at a time handing plow and hoe to the Director of Agriculture, represented by fifth- and sixth-rank pure officials;

sentences.zh: 一人掌耒耜，太常寺用本官。

translations.literal: one managing plow and hoe from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices in regular office.
translations.idiomatic: one managing plow and hoe from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices in regular office.

sentences.zh: 三公、九卿、諸侯耕牛四十，其十，副也，牛各一人。

translations.literal: Forty oxen for the Three Dukes, nine directors, and feudal lords' plowing, ten spare; one man per ox.
translations.idiomatic: Forty oxen for plowing by the Three Dukes, nine directors, and feudal lords, ten spare; one man per ox.

sentences.zh: 庶人耕牛四十，各二牛一人。

translations.literal: Forty oxen for commoners' plowing, two oxen per man.
translations.idiomatic: Forty oxen for commoners' plowing, two oxen per man.

sentences.zh: 庶人耒耜二十具、鍤二具，木為刃。

translations.literal: Twenty sets of plow and hoe for commoners, two spades with wooden blades.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty sets of plow and hoe for commoners, two spades with wooden blades.

sentences.zh: 主藉田縣令一人，具朝服，當耕時立田側，畢乃退。

translations.literal: The magistrate of the county holding the sacred field, in court dress, stood beside the field during plowing and withdrew when finished.
translations.idiomatic: The magistrate of the county holding the sacred field, in court dress, stood beside the field during plowing and withdrew when finished.

sentences.zh: 畿甸諸縣令先期集，以常服陪耕所。

translations.literal: Magistrates of metropolitan counties gathered beforehand and, in regular dress, attended the plowing place.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates of metropolitan counties gathered beforehand and, in regular dress, attended the plowing place.

sentences.zh: 耆艾二十人，陪於庶人耕位南。

translations.literal: Twenty elders accompanied south of the commoners' plowing position.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty elders accompanied south of the commoners' plowing position.

sentences.zh: 三公從者各三人，九卿、諸侯從者各一人，以助耕。

translations.literal: Each of the Three Dukes had three attendants; each of the nine directors and feudal lords one, to assist plowing.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the Three Dukes had three attendants; each of the nine directors and feudal lords one, to assist plowing.

sentences.zh: 皆絳服介幘，用其本司隸。

translations.literal: All in crimson clothes and kerchief, using their own office retainers.
translations.idiomatic: All wore crimson clothes and kerchiefs, using retainers from their own offices.

sentences.zh: 是時雖草具其儀如此，以水旱用兵而止。

translations.literal: At that time, though the ritual was drafted thus, it stopped because of flood, drought, and military campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, though the ritual was drafted thus, flood, drought, and military campaigns prevented its performance.

sentences.zh: 皇帝謁陵，行宮距陵十里，設坐於齋室，設小次於陵所道西南。

translations.literal: When the emperor worshipped at tombs, the traveling palace was ten li from the tomb; a seat was set in the fasting chamber; a small pavilion southwest of the tomb road.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor worshipped at tombs, the traveling palace stood ten li from the tomb; a seat was set in the fasting chamber and a small pavilion southwest of the tomb road.

sentences.zh: 大次於寢西南。

translations.literal: A great pavilion southwest of the sleeping chamber.
translations.idiomatic: A great pavilion southwest of the sleeping chamber.

sentences.zh: 侍臣次於大次西南，陪位者次又於西南，皆東向。

translations.literal: Attendant ministers' pavilion southwest of the great pavilion; participants' pavilion further southwest—all facing east.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant ministers' pavilion southwest of the great pavilion; participants' pavilion further southwest—all facing east.

sentences.zh: 文官於北，武官於南，朝集使又於其南，皆相地之宜。

translations.literal: Civil officials to the north, military to the south, assembly commissioners further south—all according to the ground's suitability.
translations.idiomatic: Civil officials to the north, military to the south, assembly commissioners further south—all according to the terrain.

sentences.zh: 前行二日，遣太尉告於廟。

translations.literal: Two days before, the Grand Marshal was sent to announce at the temple.
translations.idiomatic: Two days beforehand, the Grand Marshal was sent to announce at the temple.

sentences.zh: 皇帝至行宮，即齋室。

translations.literal: When the emperor reached the traveling palace, he entered the fasting chamber.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor reached the traveling palace, he entered the fasting chamber.

sentences.zh: 陵令以玉冊進署。

translations.literal: The tomb commissioner presented the jade register for signing.
translations.idiomatic: The tomb commissioner presented the jade register for signing.

sentences.zh: 設御位於陵東南隅，西向，有岡麓之閡，則隨地之宜。

translations.literal: The imperial position was set at the tomb's southeast corner, facing west; if there were hill or valley barriers, it followed the ground.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial position was set at the tomb's southeast corner, facing west; if hills or valleys intervened, placement followed the terrain.

sentences.zh: 又設位於寢宮之殿東陛之東南，西向。

translations.literal: Another position was set southeast of the eastern flight of the sleeping hall, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: Another position was set southeast of the eastern flight of the sleeping hall, facing west.

sentences.zh: 尊坫陳于堂戶東南。

translations.literal: Libation stands were arrayed southeast of the hall doors.
translations.idiomatic: Libation stands were arrayed southeast of the hall doors.

sentences.zh: 百官、行從、宗室、客使位神道左右，寢宮則分方序立大次前。

translations.literal: Officials, the procession, imperial clan, and envoys stood left and right along the spirit road; at the sleeping palace they stood in directional order before the great pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Officials, the procession, imperial clan, and envoys stood along the spirit road; at the sleeping palace they stood in directional order before the great pavilion.

sentences.zh: 其日，未明五刻，陳黃麾大仗於陵寢。

translations.literal: On that day, before the fifth watch of dawn, yellow banners and great guards were arrayed at the tomb sleeping chamber.
translations.idiomatic: On that day, before the fifth watch of dawn, yellow banners and great guards were arrayed at the tomb sleeping chamber.

sentences.zh: 三刻，行事官及宗室親五等、諸親三等以上幷客使之當陪者就位。

translations.literal: At the third watch, officiating officers and imperial clan of the fifth degree of closeness, all kindred of the third degree and above who should attend, and envoys due to accompany—all took position.
translations.idiomatic: At the third watch, officiating officers and imperial clan within the fifth degree of mourning, all kindred of the third degree and above who should attend, and envoys due to accompany—all took position.

sentences.zh: 皇帝素服乘馬，華蓋、繖、扇，侍臣騎從，詣小次。

translations.literal: The emperor in plain dress rode a horse, with canopy, parasol, and fans; attendant ministers rode in attendance and went to the small pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in plain dress rode, with canopy, parasol, and fans; attendant ministers rode in attendance to the small pavilion.

sentences.zh: 步出次，至位，再拜，又再拜。

translations.literal: He walked out of the pavilion to the position, bowed twice, and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: He walked from the pavilion to the position, bowed twice, and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 在位皆再拜，又再拜。

translations.literal: All in position bowed twice and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: All present bowed twice and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 少選，太常卿請辭，皇帝再拜，又再拜。

translations.literal: After a moment, the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requested leave; the emperor bowed twice and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: After a moment, the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requested leave; the emperor bowed twice and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 奉禮曰：「奉辭。

translations.literal: The Director of Ritual said: "Present leave."
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ritual said: "Present leave."

sentences.zh: 」在位者再拜。

translations.literal: Those in position bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: Those present bowed again.

sentences.zh: 皇帝還小次，乘馬詣大次，仗衞列立以俟行。

translations.literal: The emperor returned to the small pavilion, mounted, and went to the great pavilion; guards and escort stood in array awaiting departure.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returned to the small pavilion, mounted, and went to the great pavilion; guards and escort stood in array awaiting departure.

sentences.zh: 百官、宗室、諸親、客使序立次前。

translations.literal: Officials, imperial clan, kindred, and envoys took position in order before the pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Officials, imperial clan, kindred, and envoys took position in order before the pavilion.

sentences.zh: 皇帝步至寢宮南門，仗衞止。

translations.literal: The emperor walked to the southern gate of the sleeping palace; guards and escort halted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor walked to the southern gate of the sleeping palace; guards and escort halted.

sentences.zh: 乃入，繇東序進殿陛東南位，再拜；

translations.literal: He then entered, advanced by the eastern side to the southeastern position on the hall flight, and bowed twice;
translations.idiomatic: He entered, advanced along the eastern side to the southeastern position on the hall flight, and bowed twice;

sentences.zh: 升自東階，北向，再拜，又再拜。

translations.literal: ascended by the eastern flight, faced north, bowed twice, and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: ascended by the eastern flight, faced north, bowed twice, and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 入省服玩，抆拭帳簀，進太牢之饌，加珍羞。

translations.literal: He entered to inspect garments and furnishings, wiped curtains and mats, and advanced the great offering with delicacies.
translations.idiomatic: He entered to inspect garments and furnishings, wiped curtains and mats, and advanced the great offering with delicacies.

sentences.zh: 皇帝出尊所，酌酒，入，三奠爵，北向立。

translations.literal: The emperor came out from the libation place, poured wine, entered, and thrice set out cups, standing facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor came out from the libation place, poured wine, entered, and thrice set out cups, standing facing north.

sentences.zh: 太祝二人持玉冊于戶外，東向跪讀。

translations.literal: Two Grand Invokers held the jade register outside the door, knelt facing east and read.
translations.idiomatic: Two Grand Invokers held the jade register outside the door, knelt facing east, and read.

sentences.zh: 皇帝再拜，又再拜，乃出戶，當前北向立。

translations.literal: The emperor bowed twice and bowed twice again, then went out the door and stood before it facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor bowed twice and bowed twice again, then went out the door and stood before it facing north.

sentences.zh: 太常卿請辭，皇帝再拜，出東門，還大次，宿行宮。

translations.literal: The Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requested leave; the emperor bowed twice, went out the eastern gate, returned to the great pavilion, and lodged at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requested leave; the emperor bowed twice, went out the eastern gate, returned to the great pavilion, and lodged at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 若太子、諸王、公主陪葬柏城者，皆祭寢殿東廡；

translations.literal: If the crown prince, princes, princesses were buried in Cypress City, they were sacrificed in the eastern gallery of the sleeping hall;
translations.idiomatic: If the crown prince, princes, or princesses were buried in Cypress City, sacrifice was performed in the eastern gallery of the sleeping hall;

sentences.zh: 功臣陪葬者，祭東序。

translations.literal: meritorious ministers buried there were sacrificed in the eastern sequence.
translations.idiomatic: meritorious ministers buried there were sacrificed in the eastern sequence.

sentences.zh: 為位奠饌，以有司行事。

translations.literal: Positions were set and offerings laid; responsible offices performed the rite.
translations.idiomatic: Positions were set and offerings laid; responsible offices performed the rite.

sentences.zh: 或皇后從謁，則設大次寢宮東，先朝妃嬪次於大次南，大長公主、諸親命婦之次又於其南，皆東向。

translations.literal: If the empress accompanied the visit, a great pavilion was set east of the sleeping palace; former consorts' pavilion south of the great pavilion; great princesses and titled kindred further south—all facing east.
translations.idiomatic: If the empress accompanied the visit, a great pavilion was set east of the sleeping palace; former consorts south of it; great princesses and titled kindred further south—all facing east.

sentences.zh: 以行帷具障謁所，內謁者設皇后位於寢宮東，大次前，少東。

translations.literal: Traveling screens enclosed the visit place; inner attendants set the empress's position east of the sleeping palace, before the great pavilion, slightly east.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling screens enclosed the visit place; inner attendants set the empress's position east of the sleeping palace, before the great pavilion, slightly east.

sentences.zh: 先朝妃嬪位西南，各於次東，司贊位妃嬪東北，皆東向。

translations.literal: Former consorts southwest, each east of their pavilion; presenters northeast of the consorts—all facing east.
translations.idiomatic: Former consorts southwest, each east of her pavilion; presenters northeast of the consorts—all facing east.

sentences.zh: 皇帝既發行宮，皇后乘四望車之大次，改服假髻，白練單衣。

translations.literal: After the emperor left the traveling palace, the empress rode the four-canopy carriage's great pavilion, changed to false topknot and white plain single garment.
translations.idiomatic: After the emperor left the traveling palace, the empress rode to the great pavilion in the four-canopy carriage, changed to a false topknot and white plain single garment.

sentences.zh: 內典引導妃嬪以下就位。

translations.literal: Inner guides led consorts and below to position.
translations.idiomatic: Inner guides led consorts and those below to position.

sentences.zh: 皇后再拜，陪者皆拜。

translations.literal: The empress bowed twice; those accompanying all bowed.
translations.idiomatic: The empress bowed twice; those accompanying all bowed.

sentences.zh: 少選，遂辭，又拜，陪者皆拜。

translations.literal: After a moment she took leave, bowed again, and those accompanying all bowed.
translations.idiomatic: After a moment she took leave, bowed again, and those accompanying all bowed.

sentences.zh: 皇后還寢東大次，陪者退。

translations.literal: The empress returned to the great pavilion east of the sleeping chamber; those accompanying withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The empress returned to the great pavilion east of the sleeping chamber; those accompanying withdrew.

sentences.zh: 皇后鈿釵禮衣，乘輿詣寢宮，先朝妃嬪、大長公主以下從。

translations.literal: The empress in hairpin and ritual garment rode the carriage to the sleeping palace; former consorts and great princesses and below followed.
translations.idiomatic: The empress, in hairpin and ritual garment, rode to the sleeping palace; former consorts and great princesses and below followed.

sentences.zh: 至北門，降輿，入大次，詣寢殿前西階之西，妃嬪、公主位於西，司贊位妃嬪東北，皆東向。

translations.literal: At the northern gate she descended, entered the great pavilion, went before the western flight west of the sleeping hall; consorts and princesses west; presenters northeast of consorts—all facing east.
translations.idiomatic: At the northern gate she descended, entered the great pavilion, and went to the west of the western flight; consorts and princesses to the west; presenters northeast of the consorts—all facing east.

sentences.zh: 皇后再拜，在位者皆拜。

translations.literal: The empress bowed twice; all in position bowed.
translations.idiomatic: The empress bowed twice; all present bowed.

sentences.zh: 皇后繇西階入室，詣先帝前再拜，復詣先后前再拜，進省先后服玩，退西廂東向立，進食。

translations.literal: The empress went by the western flight into the chamber, bowed twice before the late emperor, again before the late empress, inspected the late empress's garments and furnishings, withdrew to stand east in the west wing facing east, and advanced food.
translations.idiomatic: The empress ascended by the western flight into the chamber, bowed twice before the late emperor and again before the late empress, inspected the late empress's garments and furnishings, withdrew to stand east in the west wing facing east, and advanced food.

sentences.zh: 皇帝出，乃降西階位。

translations.literal: When the emperor came out, she descended to the western flight position.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor came out, she descended to the western flight position.

sentences.zh: 辭，再拜，妃嬪皆拜。

translations.literal: She took leave and bowed twice; consorts all bowed.
translations.idiomatic: She took leave and bowed twice; consorts all bowed.

sentences.zh: 詣大次更衣，皇帝過，乃出寢宮北門，乘車還。

translations.literal: She went to the great pavilion to change garments; when the emperor passed, she went out the northern gate of the sleeping palace and rode back.
translations.idiomatic: She went to the great pavilion to change garments; when the emperor passed, she went out the northern gate of the sleeping palace and rode back.

sentences.zh: 天子不躬謁，則以太常卿行陵。

translations.literal: If the Son of Heaven did not visit in person, the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices performed tomb worship.
translations.idiomatic: If the Son of Heaven did not visit in person, the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices performed tomb worship.

sentences.zh: 所司撰日，車府令具軺車一馬清道，青衣、團扇、曲蓋繖，列俟于太常寺門。

translations.literal: The responsible office chose the day; the Carriage Office prepared one light carriage and one horse to clear the road, with green garments, round fans, and curved canopy parasol, lined up waiting at the Court of Imperial Sacrifices gate.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible office chose the day; the Carriage Office prepared one light carriage and one horse to clear the road, with green garments, round fans, and curved canopy parasol, lined up at the Court of Imperial Sacrifices gate.

sentences.zh: 設次陵南百步道東，西向。

translations.literal: A pavilion was set east of the road a hundred paces south of the tomb, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: A pavilion was set east of the road a hundred paces south of the tomb, facing west.

sentences.zh: 右校令具薙器以備汛掃。

translations.literal: The Right Construction Office prepared sweeping tools for cleaning.
translations.idiomatic: The Right Construction Office prepared sweeping tools for cleaning.

sentences.zh: 太常卿公服乘車，奉禮郎以下從。

translations.literal: The Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices in official dress rode the carriage; Directors of Ritual and below followed.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices in official dress rode the carriage; Directors of Ritual and below followed.

sentences.zh: 至次，設卿位兆門外之左，陵官位卿東南，執事又於其南，皆西向。

translations.literal: At the pavilion the director's position was left of the spirit gate outside; the tomb officer southeast of the director; attendants further south—all facing west.
translations.idiomatic: At the pavilion the director's position lay left of the spirit gate outside; the tomb officer southeast of the director; attendants further south—all facing west.

sentences.zh: 奉禮郎位陵官之西，贊引二人居南。

translations.literal: The Director of Ritual west of the tomb officer; two presenters south.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ritual west of the tomb officer; two presenters to the south.

sentences.zh: 太常卿以下再拜，在位皆拜。

translations.literal: The Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and below bowed twice; all in position bowed.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and below bowed twice; all present bowed.

sentences.zh: 謁者導卿，贊引導眾官入，奉行、復位皆拜。

translations.literal: The usher guided the director; presenters guided the host of officials in; all performed, returned to position, and bowed.
translations.idiomatic: The usher guided the director; presenters guided the host of officials in; all performed, returned to position, and bowed.

sentences.zh: 出，乘車之它陵。

translations.literal: They went out, mounted, and went to other tombs.
translations.idiomatic: They went out, mounted, and proceeded to other tombs.

sentences.zh: 有芟治，則命之。

translations.literal: If there was clearing and repair, they were ordered to do it.
translations.idiomatic: If clearing and repair were needed, orders were issued.

sentences.zh: 凡國陵之制，皇祖以上至太祖陵，皆朔、望上食，元日、冬至、寒食、伏、臘、社各一祭。

translations.literal: As for regulations of state tombs: from the imperial great-great-grandfather up to the Grand Ancestor's tomb—all received food offerings at new and full moon, and one sacrifice each on New Year, winter solstice, Cold Food, summer submission, winter submission, and the soil and grain festivals.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations for state tombs: from the imperial great-great-grandfather up to the Grand Ancestor's tomb—all received food offerings at new and full moon, and one sacrifice each on New Year, winter solstice, Cold Food, summer submission, winter submission, and the soil and grain festivals.

sentences.zh: 皇考陵，朔、望及節祭，而日進食。

translations.literal: The imperial father's tomb: new and full moon and seasonal sacrifices, with daily food offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial father's tomb: new and full moon and seasonal sacrifices, with daily food offerings.

sentences.zh: 又薦新於諸陵，其物五十有六品。

translations.literal: Fresh offerings were also sent to the various tombs, fifty-six kinds of objects.
translations.idiomatic: Fresh offerings were also sent to the various tombs—fifty-six kinds of objects.

sentences.zh: 始將進御，所司必先以送太常與尚食，滋味薦之，如宗廟。

translations.literal: When about to enter the imperial pantry, the responsible office first sent samples to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Palace Provisioner to taste the flavor and recommend them, as at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Before entering the imperial pantry, the responsible office first sent samples to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Palace Provisioner to taste and recommend them, as at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十三年，太宗謁獻陵，帝至小次，降輿，納履，入闕門，西向再拜，慟哭俯伏殆不能興。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhenguan, Taizong visited Xianling; when the emperor reached the small pavilion he descended, put on shoes, entered the gate tower, bowed west twice, wailed and prostrated himself nearly unable to rise.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Zhenguan, Taizong visited Xianling; when he reached the small pavilion he descended, put on shoes, entered the gate tower, bowed west twice, wailed and prostrated himself until he could scarcely rise.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，改服入寢宮，執饌以薦。

translations.literal: When ritual was finished he changed garments and entered the sleeping hall, bearing offerings to present.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was finished he changed garments and entered the sleeping hall, bearing offerings to present.

sentences.zh: 閱高祖及太穆后服御，悲感左右。

translations.literal: He inspected Gaozu's and Grand Empress Dowager's garments and furnishings and grieved those around him.
translations.idiomatic: He inspected Gaozu's and the Grand Empress Dowager's garments and furnishings and moved those around him to grief.

sentences.zh: 步出司馬北門，泥行二百步。

translations.literal: He walked out the Sima north gate and went two hundred paces through mud.
translations.idiomatic: He walked out the Sima north gate and went two hundred paces through mud.

sentences.zh: 永徽二年，有司言：「先帝時，獻陵既三年，惟朔、望、冬至、夏伏、臘、清明、社上食，今昭陵喪期畢，請上食如獻陵。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yonghui, the responsible office said: "In the late emperor's time, after Xianling's three-year mourning only new and full moon, winter solstice, summer submission, winter submission, Pure Brightness, and soil and grain festivals had food offerings; now Zhaoling's mourning period is complete—please offer food like Xianling.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yonghui, the responsible office said: "In the late emperor's time, after Xianling's three-year mourning only new and full moon, winter solstice, summer submission, winter submission, Pure Brightness, and soil and grain festivals had food offerings; now that Zhaoling's mourning period is complete, please offer food as at Xianling.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 六年正月朔，高宗謁昭陵，行哭就位，再拜擗踊畢，易服謁寢宮。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month in the sixth year, Gaozong visited Zhaoling, performed the arrival wailing at position, finished bowing and beating breast, changed garments and visited the sleeping hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month in the sixth year, Gaozong visited Zhaoling, performed the arrival wailing at position, finished bowing and beating his breast, changed garments, and visited the sleeping hall.

sentences.zh: 入寢哭踴，進東階，西向拜號，久，乃薦太牢之饌，加珍羞，拜哭奠饌。

translations.literal: Entering the hall he wailed and beat breast, advanced the eastern flight, faced west and cried out, long; then presented the great offering with delicacies, bowed, wailed, and set out the offering.
translations.idiomatic: Entering the hall he wailed and beat his breast, advanced the eastern flight, faced west and cried out at length, then presented the great offering with delicacies, bowing, wailing, and setting out the offering.

sentences.zh: 閱服御而後辭，行哭出寢北門，御小輦還。

translations.literal: He inspected garments and furnishings and then took leave, performed departure wailing, went out the northern gate of the sleeping chamber, and rode the small carriage back.
translations.idiomatic: He inspected garments and furnishings, then took leave, performed departure wailing, went out the northern gate of the sleeping chamber, and rode the small carriage back.

sentences.zh: 顯慶五年，詔歲春、秋季一巡，宜以三公行陵，太常少卿貳之，太常給鹵簿，仍著於令。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianqing, an edict ordered one tour each spring and autumn, with the Three Dukes performing tomb worship and the Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices assisting; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices supplied guard of honor—written into regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xianqing, an edict ordered one tour each spring and autumn, with the Three Dukes performing tomb worship and the Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices assisting; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices supplied guard of honor—written into regulations.

sentences.zh: 始，貞觀禮歲以春、秋仲月巡陵，至武后時，乃以四季月、生日、忌日遣使詣陵起居。

translations.literal: At first, Zhenguan ritual had spring and autumn mid-month tomb tours; by Empress Wu's time, envoys were sent in all four seasons, on birthdays and death anniversaries, to attend at the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: At first, Zhenguan ritual prescribed spring and autumn mid-month tomb tours; by Empress Wu's time, envoys were sent in all four seasons, on birthdays and death anniversaries, to attend at the tombs.

sentences.zh: 景龍二年，右臺侍御史唐紹上書曰：「禮不祭墓，唐家之制，春、秋仲月以使具鹵簿衣冠巡陵。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jinglong, Right Censor of the Right Office Tang Shao memorialized: "The Rites do not sacrifice at tombs; Tang regulation has spring and autumn mid-month envoys with full guard of honor and dress to tour tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jinglong, Right Censor Tang Shao memorialized: "The Rites do not sacrifice at tombs; Tang regulation has spring and autumn mid-month envoys with full guard of honor and dress to tour tombs.

sentences.zh: 天授之後，乃有起居，遂為故事。

translations.literal: After the Tianshou era came attendance, which became precedent.
translations.idiomatic: After the Tianshou era came attendance visits, which became precedent.

sentences.zh: 夫起居者，參候動止，事生之道，非陵寢法。

translations.literal: Attendance means joining to observe movement and rest—the way of the living, not tomb law.
translations.idiomatic: Attendance means joining to observe movement and rest—the way of the living, not tomb law.

sentences.zh: 請停四季及生日、忌日、節日起居，準式二時巡陵。

translations.literal: Please stop four-season, birthday, death-day, and festival attendance and follow regulation for the two seasonal tomb tours.
translations.idiomatic: Please stop four-season, birthday, death-day, and festival attendance and follow regulation for the two seasonal tomb tours.

sentences.zh: 」手敕曰：「乾陵歲冬至、寒食以外使，二忌以內使朝奉。

translations.literal: " An imperial note said: "Qianling beyond winter solstice and Cold Food uses outer envoys; the two death anniversaries use inner attendants.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial note said: "Qianling beyond winter solstice and Cold Food uses outer envoys; the two death anniversaries use inner attendants.

sentences.zh: 它陵如紹奏。

translations.literal: Other tombs as Shao memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: Other tombs as Shao memorialized.

sentences.zh: 」至是又獻、昭、乾陵皆日祭。

translations.literal: By then Xian, Zhao, and Qian tombs all had daily sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: By then Xian, Zhao, and Qian tombs all had daily sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 太常博士彭景直上疏曰：「禮無日祭陵，惟宗廟月有祭。

translations.literal: Court of Imperial Sacrifices Erudite Peng Jingzhi memorialized: "The Rites have no daily tomb sacrifice; only the ancestral temple has monthly sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Court of Imperial Sacrifices Erudite Peng Jingzhi memorialized: "The Rites prescribe no daily tomb sacrifice; only the ancestral temple has monthly sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 故王設廟、祧、壇、墠為親疎多少之數，立七廟、一壇、一墠。

translations.literal: Hence the king sets temples, distant shrines, altars, and open offerings for the number near and far; he establishes seven temples, one altar, and one open offering.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the king sets temples, distant shrines, altars, and open offerings according to degrees of kinship; he establishes seven temples, one altar, and one open offering.

sentences.zh: 曰考廟、曰王考廟、曰皇考廟、曰顯考廟，皆月祭之。

translations.literal: Father's temple, grandfather's temple, great-grandfather's temple, and remote ancestor's temple—all receive monthly sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Father's temple, grandfather's temple, great-grandfather's temple, and remote ancestor's temple—all receive monthly sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 遠廟為祧，享嘗乃止。

translations.literal: Distant temples become shrines; offering stops at the seasonal tasting.
translations.idiomatic: Distant temples become shrines; offering stops at the seasonal tasting.

sentences.zh: 去祧為壇，去壇為墠，有禱焉祭之，無禱乃止。

translations.literal: Leaving the shrine becomes an altar; leaving the altar becomes an open offering; sacrifice when there is prayer, stop when there is none.
translations.idiomatic: Leaving the shrine becomes an altar; leaving the altar becomes an open offering; sacrifice when there is prayer, stop when there is none.

sentences.zh: 又譙周祭志：『天子始祖、高祖、曾祖、祖、考之廟，皆月朔加薦，以象平生朔食，謂之月祭，二祧之廟無月祭。

translations.literal: Qiao Zhou's Sacrificial Record also says: 'The Son of Heaven's Ancestor, High Ancestor, Great Ancestor, Grandfather, and Father temples all receive monthly offering at new moon, like the living's monthly morning meal—called monthly sacrifice; the two distant temples have no monthly sacrifice.'
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Zhou's Sacrificial Record also says: 'The Son of Heaven's Ancestor, High Ancestor, Great Ancestor, Grandfather, and Father temples all receive monthly offering at new moon, like the living's monthly morning meal—called monthly sacrifice; the two distant temples have no monthly sacrifice.'

sentences.zh: 』則古皆無日祭者。

translations.literal: Thus antiquity had no daily sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Thus antiquity had no daily sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 今諸陵朔、望食，則近於古之殷事；

translations.literal: Now tomb new and full moon food is close to ancient Yin rites;
translations.idiomatic: Present tomb offerings at new and full moon resemble ancient Yin rites;

sentences.zh: 諸節日食，近於古之薦新。

translations.literal: festival-day food is close to ancient fresh offerings.
translations.idiomatic: festival-day offerings resemble ancient fresh offerings.

sentences.zh: 鄭注禮記：『殷事，月朔、半薦新之奠也。

translations.literal: Zheng's commentary on the Record of Rites: 'Yin rite: new moon and half-month fresh-offering libation.'
translations.idiomatic: Zheng's commentary on the Record of Rites: 'Yin rite: new moon and half-month fresh-offering libation.'

sentences.zh: 』又：『既大祥即四時焉。

translations.literal: Also: 'After great auspiciousness, then the four seasons.'
translations.idiomatic: Also: 'After great auspiciousness, then the four seasons.'

sentences.zh: 』此其祭皆在廟，近代始以朔、望諸節祭陵寢，唯四時及臘五享廟。

translations.literal: These sacrifices are all in the temple; only in recent times have new and full moon and festival sacrifices at tomb sleeping chambers begun, while only the four seasons and winter submission five times are offered in the temple.
translations.idiomatic: These sacrifices belong in the temple; only in recent times have new and full moon and festival sacrifices at tomb sleeping chambers begun, while only the four seasons and winter submission are offered five times in the temple.

sentences.zh: 考經據禮，固無日祭於陵。

translations.literal: Examining the classics against the Rites, there is fundamentally no daily sacrifice at tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the classics against the Rites, there is fundamentally no daily sacrifice at tombs.

sentences.zh: 唯漢七廟議，京師自高祖下至宣帝，與太上皇、悼皇考陵旁立廟，園各有寢、便殿，故日祭於寢，月祭於便殿。

translations.literal: Only Han's discussion of seven temples: from Gaozu down to Emperor Xuan, with Supreme Grandfather and Mourning Grandfather tombs, temples were set beside them; each park had sleeping chambers and side halls, hence daily sacrifice in the chamber and monthly in the side hall.
translations.idiomatic: Only Han's discussion of seven temples: from Gaozu down to Emperor Xuan, with Supreme Grandfather and Mourning Grandfather tombs, temples were set beside them; each park had sleeping chambers and side halls, hence daily sacrifice in the chamber and monthly in the side hall.

sentences.zh: 元帝時，貢禹以禮節煩數，願罷郡國廟。

translations.literal: In Emperor Yuan's time, Gong Yu because ritual was tediously numerous wished to abolish commandery and state temples.
translations.idiomatic: In Emperor Yuan's time, Gong Yu, because ritual was tediously numerous, wished to abolish commandery and state temples.

sentences.zh: 丞相韋玄成等又議七廟外，寢園皆無復。

translations.literal: Chancellor Wei Xuancheng and others also argued that beyond the seven temples, park sleeping chambers should all be restored.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Wei Xuancheng and others also argued that beyond the seven temples, park sleeping chambers should all be discontinued.

sentences.zh: 議者亦以祭不欲數，宜復古四時祭於廟。

translations.literal: Debaters also held that sacrifice should not be frequent and the ancient four-season temple sacrifice should be restored.
translations.idiomatic: Debaters also held that sacrifice should not be frequent and the ancient four-season temple sacrifice should be restored.

sentences.zh: 後劉歆引春秋傳『日祭，月祀，時享，歲貢。

translations.literal: Later Liu Xin cited the Spring and Autumn Annals: 'Daily sacrifice, monthly worship, seasonal enjoyment, yearly tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Later Liu Xin cited the Spring and Autumn Annals: 'Daily sacrifice, monthly worship, seasonal enjoyment, yearly tribute.

sentences.zh: 祖禰則日祭，曾高則月祀，二祧則時享，壇、墠則歲貢』。

translations.literal: Father and grandfather daily sacrifice; great-grandfather and remote ancestor monthly worship; two distant shrines seasonal enjoyment; altar and open offering yearly tribute.'
translations.idiomatic: Father and grandfather daily sacrifice; great-grandfather and remote ancestor monthly worship; two distant shrines seasonal enjoyment; altar and open offering yearly tribute.'

sentences.zh: 後漢陵寢之祭無傳焉，魏、晉以降，皆不祭墓。

translations.literal: Later Han tomb sleeping-chamber sacrifice has no transmission; from Wei and Jin down, tombs are not sacrificed.
translations.idiomatic: Later Han tomb sleeping-chamber sacrifice has no transmission; from Wei and Jin down, tombs are not sacrificed.

sentences.zh: 國家諸陵日祭請停如禮。

translations.literal: The state's various tombs' daily sacrifice should stop according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Daily sacrifice at the state's various tombs should stop according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 」疏奏，天子以語侍臣曰：「禮官言諸陵不當日進食。

translations.literal: " The memorial was submitted; the Son of Heaven told attendant ministers: "Ritual officers say the various tombs should not receive daily food.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted; the Son of Heaven told attendant ministers: "Ritual officers say the various tombs should not receive daily food.

sentences.zh: 夫禮以人情沿革，何專古為？

translations.literal: Ritual follows human feeling and evolves—why insist only on antiquity?
translations.idiomatic: Ritual follows human feeling and evolves—why insist only on antiquity?

sentences.zh: 乾陵宜朝晡進奠如故。

translations.literal: Qianling should continue morning and evening offerings as before.
translations.idiomatic: Qianling should continue morning and evening offerings as before.

sentences.zh: 昭、獻二陵日一進，或所司苦於費，可減朕常膳為之。

translations.literal: Zhao and Xian tombs one offering daily; if the responsible office is burdened by expense, my regular meals may be reduced to supply it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao and Xian tombs one offering daily; if the responsible office is burdened by expense, my regular meals may be reduced to supply it.

sentences.zh: 開元十五年敕：「宣皇帝、光皇帝陵，以縣令檢校，州長官歲一巡。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan fifteenth-year edict: "Xuan Emperor and Guang Emperor tombs—inspected by the county magistrate; the prefect tours once a year.
translations.idiomatic: A fifteenth-year Kaiyuan edict: "The tombs of Xuan Emperor and Guang Emperor—inspected by the county magistrate; the prefect tours once a year.

sentences.zh: 」又敕：「歲春、秋巡陵，公卿具仗出城，至陵十里復。

translations.literal: " Another edict: "Spring and autumn tomb tours—the Three Dukes with guard of honor leave the city, return ten li from the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict: "For spring and autumn tomb tours—the Three Dukes with guard of honor leave the city and return ten li from the tomb.

sentences.zh: 十七年，玄宗謁橋陵，至壖垣西闕下馬，望陵涕泗，行及神午門，號慟再拜。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Xuanzong visited Qiaoling; at the rampart's western gate he dismounted, gazed at the tomb with tears, went to the Spirit Noon Gate, cried out and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, Xuanzong visited Qiaoling; at the rampart's western gate he dismounted, gazed at the tomb with tears, went to the Spirit Noon Gate, cried out and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 且以三府兵馬供衞，遂謁定陵、獻陵、昭陵、乾陵乃還。

translations.literal: Because the Three Offices supplied military escort, he then visited Dingling, Xianling, Zhaoling, and Qianling before returning.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Three Offices supplied military escort, he then visited Dingling, Xianling, Zhaoling, and Qianling before returning.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，詔獻、昭、乾、定、橋五陵，朔、望上食，歲冬至、寒食各日設一祭。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, an edict for Xian, Zhao, Qian, Ding, and Qiao five tombs: food at new and full moon, and one sacrifice each on winter solstice and Cold Food.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, an edict for the five tombs Xian, Zhao, Qian, Ding, and Qiao: food at new and full moon, and one sacrifice each on winter solstice and Cold Food.

sentences.zh: 若節與朔、望、忌日合，即準節祭料。

translations.literal: If a festival coincided with new or full moon or a death anniversary, festival materials applied.
translations.idiomatic: If a festival coincided with new or full moon or a death anniversary, festival materials applied.

sentences.zh: 橋陵日進半羊食。

translations.literal: Qiaoling daily received half a sheep as food.
translations.idiomatic: Qiaoling daily received half a sheep as food.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，敕公卿巡陵乘輅，其令太僕寺，陵給輅二乘及仗。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, an edict that Three Dukes touring tombs ride the imperial carriage; order the Court of the Imperial Stud; tombs supply two carriages and guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, an edict that Three Dukes touring tombs ride the imperial carriage; the Court of the Imperial Stud was ordered; tombs supplied two carriages and guard.

sentences.zh: 明年，制：「以宣皇帝、光皇帝、景皇帝、元皇帝追尊號謚有制，而陵寢所奉未稱。

translations.literal: The next year, a regulation: "Xuan Emperor, Guang Emperor, Jing Emperor, and Yuan Emperor received posthumous titles and styles by regulation, yet tomb offerings did not match.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, a regulation: "Xuan Emperor, Guang Emperor, Jing Emperor, and Yuan Emperor received posthumous titles and styles by regulation, yet tomb offerings did not match.

sentences.zh: 建初、啟運陵如興寧、永康陵，置署官、陵戶，春、秋仲月，分命公卿巡謁。

translations.literal: Jianchu and Qiyun tombs like Xingning and Yongkang tombs—establish office commissioners and tomb households; spring and autumn mid-month, assign Three Dukes separately to tour and worship.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchu and Qiyun tombs, like Xingning and Yongkang tombs—establish office commissioners and tomb households; in spring and autumn mid-month, assign Three Dukes separately to tour and worship.

sentences.zh: 二十年詔：建初、啟運、興寧、永康陵，歲四時、八節，所司與陵署具食進。

translations.literal: Twentieth-year edict: Jianchu, Qiyun, Xingning, and Yongkang tombs—in all four seasons and eight festivals the responsible office and tomb commissioner together supplied food offerings.
translations.idiomatic: A twentieth-year edict: for Jianchu, Qiyun, Xingning, and Yongkang tombs—in all four seasons and eight festivals the responsible office and tomb commissioner together supplied food offerings.

sentences.zh: 」天寶二年，始以九月朔薦衣於諸陵。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianbao, offering garments to the various tombs on the first day of the ninth month began.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianbao, offering garments to the various tombs on the first day of the ninth month began.

sentences.zh: 又常以寒食薦餳粥、雞毬、雷車，五月薦衣、扇。

translations.literal: Also regularly on Cold Food, sweet porridge, chicken balls, and thunder carts were offered; in the fifth month, garments and fans.
translations.idiomatic: Also regularly on Cold Food, sweet porridge, chicken balls, and thunder carts were offered; in the fifth month, garments and fans.

sentences.zh: 陵司舊曰署，十三載改獻、昭、乾、定、橋五陵署為臺，令為臺令，陞舊一階。

translations.literal: Tomb offices were formerly called Commissions; in the thirteenth year the five tomb Commissions of Xian, Zhao, Qian, Ding, and Qiao were changed to Bureaus, commissioners to Bureau Directors, each raised one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Tomb offices were formerly called Commissions; in the thirteenth year the five tomb Commissions of Xian, Zhao, Qian, Ding, and Qiao were changed to Bureaus, commissioners to Bureau Directors, each raised one rank.

sentences.zh: 是後諸陵署皆稱臺。

translations.literal: Afterward all tomb offices were called Bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward all tomb offices were called Bureaus.

sentences.zh: 大曆十四年，禮儀使顏真卿奏：「今元陵請朔、望、節祭，日薦，如故事；

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Dali, Ritual Commissioner Yan Zhenqing memorialized: "Now Yuanling requests new and full moon, festival sacrifice, and daily offering, as before;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Dali, Ritual Commissioner Yan Zhenqing memorialized: "Now Yuanling requests new and full moon, festival sacrifice, and daily offering, as before;

sentences.zh: 泰陵惟朔、望、歲冬至、寒食、伏、臘、社一祭，而罷日食。

translations.literal: Tailing only new and full moon, winter solstice, Cold Food, summer submission, winter submission, and soil and grain festival once each, stopping daily food.
translations.idiomatic: Tailing only new and full moon, winter solstice, Cold Food, summer submission, winter submission, and soil and grain festival once each, stopping daily food.

sentences.zh: 」制曰：「可。

translations.literal: " The regulation said: "Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The regulation said: "Approved.

sentences.zh: 」貞元四年，國子祭酒包佶言：「歲二月、八月，公卿朝拜諸陵，陵臺所由導至陵下，禮略無以盡恭。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhenyuan, Guozi Libationer Bao Ji said: "In the second and eighth months the Three Dukes worship at the various tombs; the tomb bureau guides them to the tomb, but ritual is too brief to show full respect.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhenyuan, Guozi Libationer Bao Ji said: "In the second and eighth months the Three Dukes worship at the various tombs; the tomb bureau guides them to the tomb, but ritual is too brief to show full respect.

sentences.zh: 」於是太常約舊禮草定曰：「所司先撰吉日，公卿輅車、鹵簿就太常寺發，抵陵南道東設次，西向北上。

translations.literal: " Thereupon the Court of Imperial Sacrifices drafted from old ritual: "The responsible office first selects an auspicious day; the Three Dukes' carriage and guard of honor depart from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, reach south of the tomb road, set a pavilion east, facing west and advancing north.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Court of Imperial Sacrifices drafted from old ritual: "The responsible office first selects an auspicious day; the Three Dukes' carriage and guard of honor depart from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, reach south of the tomb road, set a pavilion to the east, facing west and advancing north.

sentences.zh: 公卿既至次，奉禮郎設位北門外之左，陵官位其東南，執事官又於其南。

translations.literal: When the Three Dukes reached the pavilion, the Director of Ritual set position left of the north gate outside; the tomb officer southeast of the director; officiating officers further south.
translations.idiomatic: When the Three Dukes reached the pavilion, the Director of Ritual set position left of the north gate outside; the tomb officer southeast of the director; officiating officers further south.

sentences.zh: 謁者導公卿，典引導眾官就位，皆拜。

translations.literal: The usher guided the Three Dukes; the ritual guide guided the host of officials to position; all bowed.
translations.idiomatic: The usher guided the Three Dukes; the ritual guide guided the host of officials to position; all bowed.

sentences.zh: 公卿、眾官以次奉行，拜而還。

translations.literal: The Three Dukes and host of officials performed in turn, bowed, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Dukes and host of officials performed in turn, bowed, and returned.

sentences.zh: 故事，朝陵公卿發，天子視事不廢。

translations.literal: By precedent, when the Three Dukes departed for tomb worship the Son of Heaven continued audience without interruption.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, when the Three Dukes departed for tomb worship the Son of Heaven continued audience without interruption.

sentences.zh: 十六年，拜陵官發，會董晉卒，廢朝。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, when tomb-worship officials departed, Dong Jin died and audience was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, when tomb-worship officials departed, Dong Jin died and audience was suspended.

sentences.zh: 是後公卿發，乃因之不視事。

translations.literal: Afterward when the Three Dukes departed, audience was therefore not held.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, when the Three Dukes departed, audience was therefore not held.

sentences.zh: 元和元年，禮儀使杜黃裳請如故事，豐陵日祭，崇陵唯祭朔、望、節日、伏、臘。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanhe, Ritual Commissioner Du Huangchang requested as precedent: Fengling daily sacrifice; Chongling only new and full moon, festivals, summer submission, and winter submission.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanhe, Ritual Commissioner Du Huangchang requested as precedent: Fengling daily sacrifice; Chongling only new and full moon, festivals, summer submission, and winter submission.

sentences.zh: 二年，宰臣建言：「禮有著定，後世徇一時之慕，過於煩，幷故陵廟有薦新，而節有遣使，請歲太廟以時享，朔、望上食，諸陵以朔、望奠，親陵以朝晡奠，其餘享及忌日告陵皆停。

translations.literal: In the second year, chancellors proposed: "Ritual has fixed norms; later ages indulged momentary devotion and became excessively burdensome; former tombs and temples also had fresh offerings, and festivals had dispatched envoys—please have the Grand Temple seasonal offerings, new and full moon food offerings, various tombs new and full moon libations, close tombs morning and evening libations; stop the rest of offerings and death-day tomb announcements.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, chancellors proposed: "Ritual has fixed norms; later ages indulged momentary devotion and became excessively burdensome; former tombs and temples also had fresh offerings, and festivals had dispatched envoys—please have the Grand Temple seasonal offerings, new and full moon food offerings, various tombs new and full moon libations, close tombs morning and evening libations; stop the rest of offerings and death-day tomb announcements.
